datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys to collect IPC classification data across Madagascar administrative units. Geographic boundaries were mapped with corresponding food insecurity phase classifications and scenario projections for near-term forecasting of acute food insecurity impacts.
